opening.argument: The pitch begins with a striking promise: turn $100 into a quarter of a million dollars in three years, then urges viewers to lend that first $100 and join BitConnect. It pairs that projected return with instructions to reinvest accumulated interest and assurances that viewers will get their money back and lose nothing. The spreadsheet’s $100 starting amount, interest calculations, and highlighted $10 reinvestment cell reinforce the compounding pitch. A separate visible BitConnect page links a larger investment threshold to an annual-ceremony opportunity. But the views do not establish that any projected return or benefit was realized, and the speaker allows that the outcome could be lower.
